notes: Reached via Claude-in-Chrome only. robots.txt (https://beruru.com/robots.txt) is a standard Shopify robots file, User-agent:* Allow:/, no Claude-specific disallow - no block. Site is Shopify (beruru.com, www redirects to non-www; canonical origin used for all links is https://beruru.com/). Beruru is an 'Outdoor Lifestyle Brand for Homes and Gardens' (per own meta description) and its ENTIRE furniture assortment is filed under an 'Outdoor Furniture' department - confirmed by walking the header mega-menu, the collections sitemap (https://beruru.com/sitemap_collections_1.xml, 102 collection handles), and the on-page sub-category chips of /collections/outdoor-furniture (Garden Chairs, Benches, Outdoor table, Outdoor Sofa, Swings) plus a nested filtered view for Pouffes. Prior Home-Decor pass (notes/257.md) explicitly excluded 'all Furniture (seating/tables/cabinetry/doors)' from its scope, confirming furniture exists on-site but was out of scope for that project - this pass captures it. Qty method: rendered listing header 'N PRODUCTS' text (Rule 1), cross-checked in every case against same-origin fetch('/collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250') array length (Rule 3 enumeration) via javascript_tool - all values agreed exactly, no discrepancies found (Shopify's own inflated products_count META FIELD was not used anywhere; the products.json array is a real product listing, distinct from that known-inflated field). /collections/benches and /collections/outdoor-bench are duplicate aliases for the identical 5-product set (verified by comparing product title arrays) - recorded once as 'Benches' using the shorter canonical handle. /collections/outdoor-furniture/pouffes is a nested filtered view under the Outdoor Furniture collection (not a real standalone Shopify collection - its own /products.json 404s); its qty came from the rendered page's 'PRODUCTS' header, matching Trap-2 pattern from the brief (bad/nested slug served under the parent's own theme template, H1 still shows 'Outdoor Furniture' but the grid is correctly filtered to 1 product, confirmed by inspecting the actual product tile). 'Outdoor Table' (89 products, own working /collections/outdoor-table with matching header+products.json) was treated as a grouping row rather than a leaf because four more specific standalone collections exist in the mega-menu (Dining/Coffee/Side/Console Table, each with its own working page+count) - per the URL-hierarchy rule the deeper/more specific URLs were recorded instead of the broader rollup; note the children do not sum to the parent's 89 (8+23+25+4=60) because Shopify's per-type collections are tag-based and overlap with the broader table rollup rather than partition it - this is expected for faceted collections and does not indicate an error. 'Stools', 'Shelves' and 'Doors & Partition' are real standalone furniture-type nav/sitemap collections that are NOT chip-children of the Outdoor Furniture page itself (they sit in the same mega-menu column but link directly, e.g. Stools' mega-menu href is malformed/unencoded '/collections/outdoor-stools/stools&barstools' - the canonical single-segment /collections/outdoor-stools was used instead, both 200 with matching counts) - recorded as flat leaves under the same 'Outdoor Furniture' top category rather than as chip-children of the group row. Checked product-level detail for the single-item 'Shelves' collection: it is a 120x32x75cm freestanding indoor console/shelf unit (product_type='Shelves', tags include 'console tables'/'tables') - genuinely furniture per the shelving-line rule (freestanding, not a decorative wall shelf), no flag needed. Checked product-level detail for 'Doors & Partition' (1 product, 'Carved Wooden Divider', 152x7x182cm, tags 'Panel Screens'/'Wooden Screens') - a freestanding wooden room-divider screen; included as furniture-adjacent freestanding furniture with a manual-review flag since the brief's include/exclude lists do not explicitly name room dividers/screens. EXCLUDED as out of scope for this task: all of Beruru's non-furniture catalogue (planters, garden accessories/tools, tableware/serveware, kitchenware, lighting of every kind, mirrors, wall decor, artefacts, sculptures, candles, door mats, faux plants, birds-of-india, fountains - a garden water feature). Also excluded three categories of navigation junk per project rule #3 and the brief's non-navigable-rollup guidance: (1) the 'seating' collection (85 products) - present in the collections sitemap but NOT linked anywhere in the header mega-menu, an auto-generated tag rollup with a count that doesn't cleanly match any real sub-type combination, not a genuine browsable node; (2) SEO/city landing pages not in the mega-menu: garden-furniture-online (4), outdoor-furniture-online (38), balcony-furniture-online (250-capped, likely a near-duplicate of the whole catalogue); (3) marketing/operational rollups not in the mega-menu: best-selling-furnitures (20, a bestseller marketing collection) and furniture-2026-back-order (31, a backorder/inventory-status cross-cut, not a product-type category). Sanity checks: every leaf's rendered header count matched its own products.json enumeration exactly (agreement, not just plausibility); none of the counts were suspiciously round; each collection's own H1 was confirmed to match the intended node (no parent-listing-under-child-slug traps found on any of the URLs actually recorded as leaves).
